declaration: This environment is now THE BENCHMARK. No more opponent evolution, no M1 tuning, no tagging or suppression changes, no ruleset edits. Everything downstream is measured against this fixed target.
why_freeze_now: the environment has passed the full prospective test it was built to pass. Any further change to it would invalidate the four-gate validation and make every downstream learning result incomparable to the evidence that justifies running them.

A.mechanism: conditional defender: deploys only while at least 2 RED agents are alive

frozen_scripted_responses.role: these defined the scripted validation. Learned policies replace them downstream; the scripted pair remains the reference anchor.

frozen_observability_definitions.intent: >=2 live untagged RED agents all on BLUE's home side, persisting INTENT_PERSIST=4 consecutive steps, via engine _is_on_home_side
frozen_observability_definitions.commitment: >=2 live untagged BLUE agents all on RED's home side

spent_and_disqualified_blocks.2600001: PERMANENTLY DISQUALIFIED (collides with g0_v2 penalty-ablation training)

implementation_note_for_downstream_train.issue: the A pole's overlay is applied ONLY by experiments/sds_genome.py::apply_genome_to_core. The PPO training path (rl/training/env_factory.py) does set_phase / set_next_opponent / _apply_initial_opponent_params and does NOT apply any genome overlay.
implementation_note_for_downstream_train.risk: training 'against pole A' without explicitly applying the overlay would silently train against plain OP6, and every downstream repertoire result would be measuring the wrong environment.
implementation_note_for_downstream_train.verified_empirically: the override survives env.reset() AND survives auto-reset across episode termination (checked on a live env: min_alive_for_defender=2 still set after 2 terminal transitions).
implementation_note_for_downstream_train.requirement: any training or evaluation run against pole A MUST apply the overlay and MUST assert it is live on the concrete core object before consuming compute.

prohibited_permanently: evolving further opponents for this benchmark
tuning M1 or any ruleset parameter
changing tagging, suppression, or carrier vulnerability
changing the intent or commitment definitions
changing map, team size, or horizon
re-using any spent or disqualified seed block
